map.在 pH、[H⁺]、[OH⁻]、pOH 四种模式间换算：pH = -log₁₀[: Converts among pH, [H+], [OH-] and pOH: pH = -log10[H+], range 0-14, and reports whether the solution is acidic or alkaline.
map.pH = -log₁₀[H⁺]；pOH = 14 − pH；[H⁺] = 10⁻: pH = -log10[H+]; pOH = 14 - pH; [H+] = 10^-pH; [OH-] = 10^-pOH. pH is limited to 0-14.
map.结果区显示其余三种量及酸碱性。: The result area shows the other three quantities and whether the solution is acidic or alkaline.
map.溶液酸碱度评估。: Assess the acidity or alkalinity of the solution.
map.pH=7 在 25℃ 为中性；温度不同中性 pH 会偏移。: pH 7 is neutral at 25C; at other temperatures the neutral pH shifts.
map.在 25℃ 下是；温度变化会改变中性点的 pH。: At 25C, yes; temperature changes shift the neutral point pH.
